newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwaiti Christian convert reverts to Islam - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti Christian convert reverts to Islam - paper.

text.p: A Kuwaiti convert to Christianity who had been declared an apostate by a Moslem Shi'ite court has reverted to Islam, a newspaper reported on Friday.
"I clear myself from any religion that contradicts with Islam," al-Rai al-Aam quoted Robert Hussein as telling a Moslem cleric in Kuwait after declaring himself a Moslem again.

A Kuwait Shi'ite court, ruling on a private civil suit brought against Hussein by three Islamist lawyers, declared Hussein an apostate last May 29 in the first such finding by a court in the conservative Gulf Arab state.

Hussein, who announced his conversion to a newspaper in 1995, went to the United States in August saying he feared for his life after a court ruling that he said could be interpreted by Moslems as permission to kill him. Public abandonment of Islam is rare in the Arab world.
Hussein was not immediately available for comment.
He married an American Christian missionary before returning to Kuwait earlier this month. The newspaper said Hussein's wife wants to convert to Islam.
